content.json:
# Defender CSPM ダッシュボード
Microsoft Defender for Cloud（Defender CSPM）が収集したセキュリティ態勢データを、Azure Resource Graph から取得して可視化します。上部でサブスクリプションと環境（Azure / AWS / GCP など）を絞り込み、タブを切り替えて確認してください。

parameters.name: Subscriptions
parameters.label: サブスクリプション
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| project value = id, label = name, selected = true
| order by label asc

parameters.name: Environment
parameters.label: 環境 (Azure / AWS / GCP など)
parameters.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/assessments"
| extend env = tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Source)
| where isnotempty(env)
| distinct env
| order by env asc
| project value = env, label = env

links.linkLabel: 規制コンプライアンス

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/securescores"
| where name =~ "ascScore"
| summarize value = round(avg(todouble(properties.score.percentage)) * 100, 1), subs = dcount(subscriptionId)
| extend title = "平均セキュア スコア (%)", subtitle = strcat(subs, " サブスクリプションの平均")
content.noDataMessage: 該当するデータがありません。

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/assessments"
| extend env = tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Source)
| where "*" in ({Environment}) or env in ({Environment})
| extend status = tostring(properties.status.code)
| extend severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity)
| extend riskLevel = tostring(properties.risk.level)
| extend recName = tostring(properties.displayName)
| extend resId = coalesce(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Id), tostring(properties.resourceDetails.id), extract(@"(?i)^(.*)/providers/microsoft.security/assessments/", 1, id))
| where status == "Unhealthy"
| summarize value = dcount(name)
| extend title = "未対応の推奨事項（種類）", subtitle = "異常 (Unhealthy) 状態"

content.json:
> **補足**
> - **リスク レベル**と**攻撃パス**は、Defender CSPM（有償）を有効にしたサブスクリプション・コネクタでのみ表示されます。
> - セキュア スコアは Azure Resource Graph 上のスコアです。Defender ポータルの「クラウド セキュア スコア」（リスクベース）とは計算方法が異なる場合があります。
> - Azure Resource Graph への反映には時間差があります。

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/securescores"
| where name =~ "ascScore"
| extend scorePct = round(todouble(properties.score.percentage) * 100, 1), current = round(todouble(properties.score.current), 2), maxScore = todouble(properties.score.max), weight = tolong(properties.weight)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions" | project subscriptionId, subscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| project subscription = coalesce(subscriptionName, subscriptionId), scorePct, current, maxScore, weight
| order by scorePct asc
content.title: サブスクリプション別のセキュア スコア
content.noDataMessage: 該当するデータがありません。

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/securescores/securescorecontrols"
| extend controlName = tostring(properties.displayName), current = todouble(properties.score.current), maxScore = coalesce(todouble(properties.score.max), todouble(properties.definition.properties.maxScore)), unhealthy = tolong(properties.unhealthyResourceCount), healthy = tolong(properties.healthyResourceCount), notApplicable = tolong(properties.notApplicableResourceCount)
| summarize current = round(sum(current), 2), maxScore = sum(maxScore), unhealthy = sum(unhealthy), healthy = sum(healthy), notApplicable = sum(notApplicable), subscriptions = dcount(subscriptionId) by controlName
| extend potentialIncrease = round(maxScore - current, 2), pct = iff(maxScore > 0, round(current / maxScore * 100, 1), 0.0)
| project controlName, pct, potentialIncrease, current, maxScore, unhealthy, healthy, notApplicable, subscriptions
| order by potentialIncrease desc

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/assessments"
| extend env = tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Source)
| where "*" in ({Environment}) or env in ({Environment})
| extend status = tostring(properties.status.code)
| extend severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity)
| extend riskLevel = tostring(properties.risk.level)
| extend recName = tostring(properties.displayName)
| extend resId = coalesce(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Id), tostring(properties.resourceDetails.id), extract(@"(?i)^(.*)/providers/microsoft.security/assessments/", 1, id))
| where name == "{SelectedAssessmentKey}"
| where status == "Unhealthy"
| extend riskJa = case(riskLevel =~ "Critical", "重大", riskLevel =~ "High", "高", riskLevel =~ "Medium", "中", riskLevel =~ "Low", "低", "リスク評価なし")
| extend resourceName = coalesce(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.ResourceName), extract(@"([^/]+)$", 1, resId))
| extend portal = tostring(properties.links.azurePortal)
| extend portalLink = iff(isempty(portal), "", iff(portal startswith "http", portal, strcat("https://", portal)))
| extend riskFactors = tostring(properties.risk.riskFactors)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions" | project subscriptionId, subscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| extend riskOrder = case(riskJa == "重大", 1, riskJa == "高", 2, riskJa == "中", 3, riskJa == "低", 4, 5)
| order by riskOrder asc
| project resourceName, resId, env, riskJa, riskFactors, subscription = coalesce(subscriptionName, subscriptionId), portalLink

content.json: ガバナンス ルールで割り当てた推奨事項の対応状況（担当者・期限）を表示します。ガバナンス ルールを設定していない場合は表示されません。

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/assessments/governanceassignments"
| extend assessmentId = tolower(extract(@"(?i)^(.*)/governanceassignments/[^/]+$", 1, id))
| extend owner = tostring(properties.owner), dueDate = todatetime(properties.remediationDueDate), grace = tobool(properties.isGracePeriod)
| join kind=leftouter (securityresources | where type == "microsoft.security/assessments" | project assessmentId = tolower(id), status = tostring(properties.status.code), recName = tostring(properties.displayName), severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity), resId = tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Id)) on assessmentId
| extend govStatus = case(status == "Healthy", "完了", isnull(dueDate), "期限なし", dueDate < now(), "期限超過", "期限内")
| summarize count() by govStatus
content.title: 対応状況

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/assessments/governanceassignments"
| extend assessmentId = tolower(extract(@"(?i)^(.*)/governanceassignments/[^/]+$", 1, id))
| extend owner = tostring(properties.owner), dueDate = todatetime(properties.remediationDueDate), grace = tobool(properties.isGracePeriod)
| join kind=leftouter (securityresources | where type == "microsoft.security/assessments" | project assessmentId = tolower(id), status = tostring(properties.status.code), recName = tostring(properties.displayName), severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity), resId = tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Id)) on assessmentId
| extend govStatus = case(status == "Healthy", "完了", isnull(dueDate), "期限なし", dueDate < now(), "期限超過", "期限内")

| extend completedPct = iff(total > 0, round(todouble(completed) / todouble(total) * 100, 1), 0.0)
| order by overdue desc

サブスクリプションごとの Defender for Cloud プランの有効化状況です。

- **Defender CSPM** が無効のサブスクリプションでは、攻撃パス分析、リスクの優先度付け、Cloud Security Explorer などが使えません。
- 「—」は無効、または未設定のプランです。
- AWS / GCP の環境は、セキュリティ コネクタ側でプランを設定します（ここに表示されるのは Azure サブスクリプションのプランです）。

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/pricings"
| extend plan = name, tier = tostring(properties.pricingTier), subPlan = tostring(properties.subPlan)
| summarize n_cspm = countif(plan =~ "CloudPosture" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_servers = countif(plan =~ "VirtualMachines" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_containers = countif(plan =~ "Containers" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_storage = countif(plan =~ "StorageAccounts" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_sql = countif(plan =~ "SqlServers" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_sqlvm = countif(plan =~ "SqlServerVirtualMachines" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_ossdb = countif(plan =~ "OpenSourceRelationalDatabases" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_cosmos = countif(plan =~ "CosmosDbs" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_appsvc = countif(plan =~ "AppServices" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_kv = countif(plan =~ "KeyVaults" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_arm = countif(plan =~ "Arm" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_api = countif(plan =~ "Api" and tier =~ "Standard"), n_ai = countif(plan =~ "AI" and tier =~ "Standard"), serversP2 = countif(plan =~ "VirtualMachines" and tier =~ "Standard" and subPlan =~ "P2") by subscriptionId
| extend cspm = iff(n_cspm > 0, "✅ 有効", "⛔ 無効（Foundational のみ）"), servers = iff(n_servers > 0, iff(serversP2 > 0, "✅ Plan 2", "✅ Plan 1"), "—")
| extend containers = iff(n_containers > 0, "✅ 有効", "—"), storage = iff(n_storage > 0, "✅ 有効", "—"), sql = iff(n_sql > 0, "✅ 有効", "—"), sqlvm = iff(n_sqlvm > 0, "✅ 有効", "—"), ossdb = iff(n_ossdb > 0, "✅ 有効", "—"), cosmos = iff(n_cosmos > 0, "✅ 有効", "—"), appsvc = iff(n_appsvc > 0, "✅ 有効", "—"), kv = iff(n_kv > 0, "✅ 有効", "—"), arm = iff(n_arm > 0, "✅ 有効", "—"), api = iff(n_api > 0, "✅ 有効", "—"), ai = iff(n_ai > 0, "✅ 有効", "—")
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions" | project subscriptionId, subscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| project subscription = coalesce(subscriptionName, subscriptionId), cspm, servers, containers, storage, sql, sqlvm, ossdb, cosmos, appsvc, kv, arm, api, ai
| order by cspm desc, subscription asc
